name: manual_67ddcb
claim: openclaw.json's .cron.jobs schema is NOT the raw shape shown in some skill docs (id/agentId/schedule.type/schedule.value/prompt) — hand-editing that shape breaks config validation silently until 'openclaw config validate' or 'openclaw status' surfaces 'cron: Invalid input'. Always use 'openclaw cron add --agent X --every/--cron/--at ... --message ...' CLI instead of jq-editing openclaw.json directly.
conditions: openclaw cron jobs.json schema invalid config gateway

decisions.notes: Hand-edited cron job via jq per a skill's example schema 2026-06-29, broke live gateway (port unreachable, launchd showed running but app exited on invalid config). Restored from backup, then used 'openclaw cron add' CLI successfully — it has its own schema (schedule.kind/everyMs, payload.kind, etc.) that differs from the skill doc's jq example.
